info.title: Bayt Al-Quran API
info.description: API documentation for Bayt Al-Quran LMS, including Jitsi Meet live sessions, individual and group sessions management.

description.example: مراجعة الجزء الثلاثين مع تصحيح المخارج

link.description: Room URL (auto-generated Jitsi URL if omitted during creation)

isGroup.description: true for group sessions, false for 1-on-1 sessions

maxStudents.description: Maximum allowed students for group session

notification_Time.description: Minutes before start to send reminders

groupStudents.description: List of students enrolled in this session (for group sessions)

link.description: Optional custom meeting link. If omitted, Jitsi room URL is generated automatically.

isGroup.description: Set true for group session, false for 1-on-1 individual session

studentId.description: Student ID. Required if isGroup is false (individual session)

studentIds.description: Array of Student IDs. Required if isGroup is true (group session)

maxStudents.description: Maximum capacity of students for group session

token.description: Signed Jitsi JWT token for this user and room

roomName.description: Unique Jitsi room identifier for this schedule

url.description: Direct URL to open the meeting room in browser, webview, or iframe

domain.description: Jitsi server domain (pass to @jitsi/react-sdk or JitsiMeetExternalAPI)

isModerator.description: true for teachers and admins (with moderator tools like mute all and recording), false for students

comment.example: حصة ممتازة وطالب متميز ما شاء الله

post.description: Creates a single live session. For Individual session: set isGroup=false (or omit) and provide studentId. For Group session: set isGroup=true, provide studentIds array, and optional maxStudents. If link is omitted, a unique Jitsi Meet room is automatically generated.

value.title: حصة تجويد فردية
value.description: تسميع سورة النساء مع أحكام النون الساكنة

post.description: Creates repeating sessions based on days of the week. Supports both individual (studentId) and group (isGroup=true + studentIds). Validates student balances and decrements sessions atomically.

delete.description: Cancels the session and automatically refunds remaining sessions to the student(s) enrolled.
Cancels all future recurring sessions in a series and refunds remaining sessions to enrolled students.

200.description: Recurring group sessions cancelled and refunded successfully

get.description: Retrieve all sessions with pagination, student/teacher name search, and start/end date filtering. Includes teacher, student, and enrolled groupStudents.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by student or teacher name

get.description: Returns sessions for the authenticated user based on their JWT token. For Teachers: returns sessions they teach. For Students: returns individual 1-on-1 sessions and group sessions where they are enrolled.

post.description: Main entrypoint for Teacher, Student, or Admin to join a live session. Returns a signed Jitsi JWT token, dynamic roomName (bayt-session-ID), full join URL, and domain. Teachers join as Moderators (with screen share, recording, mute all controls); Students join as Participants. Also records join timestamp for attendance tracking.

200.description: Session joined successfully; returns token, room, and URL

400.description: Session is cancelled, completed, or missed

403.description: User is not enrolled or authorized to join this session

post.description: Call this endpoint when user exits the meeting room. Records leave timestamp, calculates actual attended duration in minutes, and updates attendance logs.

200.description: Session left successfully and duration recorded

post.description: Allows submitting rating (1-5), review comments, and confirming teacher/student attendance.
